The Export button now works, and the fix is committed as `a6e5220`.

**Cause:** In `src/orders-web/orders_page.py`, `__init__` registered only the "refresh" button. `click("export")` found no handler and did nothing. `export()` itself was fine, which is why the existing test passed: it called the method directly, not through the button.

**Fix:** I registered the handler with `self._on("export", self.export)`, the same way refresh is registered. I also added `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which clicks the button. It fails without the fix and passes with it. The full suite runs 9 tests and they all pass.

The commit includes only `orders_page.py` and `tests/test_orders_web.py`. I left out your uncommitted README note ("ask whether Export should include cancelled orders") and the untracked `notes/` directory. The export still includes every order, including cancelled ones, so that README question is still open if you want to change it.
